content.short: Liquity is a decentralized borrowing platform with interest-free loans secured by collateralized ETH.
content.description: Liquity is a non-custodial, governance-free DeFi protocol founded in 2019 by Robert Lauko. It issues loans in LUSD, its USD-pegged stablecoin, with each loan secured by collateralized ETH. A stability pool and fellow borrowers act as guarantors to support loan performance and the overall system’s resilience. Developers can access Liquity’s API to integrate endpoints into their programs, enabling seamless on-chain lending integrations.

resources.title: A Beginner's Guide to Trove Management
resources.tldr: Troves are the collateral positions the whole protocol runs on, and mismanaging one is how people get liquidated. Explains what to watch and when to act.
